comment: EPO03 PROD-WORLD-WEST pending regions (DIR-01 territory 0-320 x 300-700). x,y = crop origin on the 1024^2 atlas; w,h = crop size (generation and mask are exactly this size). `rect` is the authored rect in CROP coords (half-open) and equals the inpaint rect; a coordinate outside [0,w)/[0,h) is the canvas edge (ramp 0). Ramps are one-sided from the rect edge rising inward, width-jittered +/-60%: 24 free edge, 32 across a texture change. Salts 80-99 are this team's. Ids WA/WB/WC (FMPO02 already used W1-W3). Order: WA (upper core face, coreAuthor D0033) -> WB (pass road + foothills + lower face, one hand; re-extracts the four west road goldens) -> WC (wall foot + downs, carries the beck to y=700 for SOUTH). Each crop is cut from the composite the previous region shipped into. The fairy glade 296-416 x 392-496 is LANDMARKS' (L1): WA's mask ends at x 296 so woodland is left there for the glade.

regions.name: core_face_upper
regions.intent: The core forest's west face above the road (the vertical wall at x~256, y 300-494, inside the A-4 rim FMPO02 could not write) breaks westward into bays, promontories and stepping copses that meet W1's meadow copses; firs at the top, oaks below; the wood east of x 296 stays unbroken for the fairy glade; Greenwatch (286,431) keeps a forest edge.

regions.name: pass_road_foothills
regions.intent: One hand: the caravan road leaves the wood's west bays at (256,515), runs west through the caravan corridor (199-245 x 506-532 keeps road), threads a col between two rock shoulders at Wayfarer's Pass (187,542), fords a beck and switchbacks up into the Worldspine's foothills to leave the west edge; the far-west grey slab becomes scree fans, rock knolls and a snow-line; the pasted peak (210,590) becomes part of the range; the beck turns south past it; the lower core face (256-304 x 460-590) breaks into bays; Deepwood Shrine (304,556) stays deep wood; the stag (156-184 x 493-515) keeps meadow.

regions.name: wall_foot_downs
regions.intent: W3's downs retouched: the Worldspine's foot continues south from WB as scree and boulder outcrops along the west edge down to y 700 (SOUTH's edge), and the beck WB turned south runs on through the gorse downs to leave at y 700 for SOUTH's SW shore; the downs' gorse and outcrops east of the beck kept in W3's hand.
